## Verdict

Lumen Path costs least for a team of 30, at $270 per month. All three minimums fall below the team size, so every vendor bills for exactly 30 seats and the ranking follows the per-seat rate directly.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Gable | $21 | 1 |
| Lumen Path | $9 | 10 |
| Estuary | $14 | 25 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the larger of 30 and the vendor minimum. At 30 people, no minimum binds.

- **Lumen Path:** minimum 10 < 30, so 30 seats paid. 30 × $9 = **$270 per month**.
- **Estuary:** minimum 25 < 30, so 30 seats paid. 30 × $14 = **$420 per month**.
- **Gable:** minimum 1 < 30, so 30 seats paid. 30 × $21 = **$630 per month**.

Lumen Path is $150 per month cheaper than Estuary and $360 per month cheaper than Gable — $1,800 and $4,320 over twelve months.

## Risks

This ranking is unusually stable, because no minimum applies at 30 seats. Costs scale linearly at $9, $14 and $21 per added person, so Lumen Path stays cheapest at every size above 30 and its absolute lead widens with growth.

Shrinking changes things. Below 25 people Estuary starts billing a 25-seat floor of $350; below 10 people Lumen Path bills $90. Gable's 1-seat minimum means it never charges for unused capacity, which matters only if headcount drops sharply.

The price list gives per-seat rates and minimums and nothing else. Features, support tiers, usage limits and security posture are unknown, so this says which vendor is cheapest, not which is the better buy — Gable's premium may be buying something.

All figures assume monthly billing as stated. Annual commitments, volume discounts at 30+ seats, and onboarding or migration costs are not on the price list and could reorder these totals.
